facts.fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone strategy says BSL has a process for tracking complaints and redressals, with its Consumer Protection Section holding commercial bank complaint data and mobile money providers reporting complaints to BSL.
The Bank of Sierra Leone strategy reports complaints tracked from mobile money providers in a period ending 2021: 12,993 cash reversals, 5,748 fraud, 1,793 PIN resets and 498 account unlocks.
